Wed at 2024-03-27T13:00:00-04:00 @Michael Stoll will speak in the Rutgers Lean seminar. (Same zoom link as others, or DM me for the link.)

Title: Why I am doing L-series in Lean

Abstract: I am an arithmetic geometer and not an analytic number theorist, but I am currently working on getting results on L-series into Mathlib. I will tell the story of how and why I got there, and what I really would like to be able to do.

Here's the video recording of the lecture:
